name: saasplane
description: The SaaS Plane agent plugin marketplace — the stack-agnostic core plugin (persona, contract rules, command vocabulary, cross-repo protocol, generated-file guard) and one plugin per provider instance, named spn-<domain>-<instance>.

plugins.name: spn-core
plugins.description: SaaS Plane core, stack-agnostic: the DevEx stage skills (check, scm, ideate, plan, develop, test, provision, deliver, operate, report) — including ideate, the interactive loop that decides a boundary and shape into the repo-root CONCEPT.md before anything is planned; the SPN engineer persona; the spn-panel reviewer and the lens files it convenes (lead, business, product, architect, server-dev, web-dev, qa, infra, trust, partner, voice); contract review rules; the command vocabulary; the doc-set rules every node's docs are built to; the cross-repo working protocol; the getting-started digest; the new-platform intake worksheet; a hook that denies hand-edits to generated files; and a hook that checks every document — seats, READMEs, the concept, the artifacts — against the bars the book states mechanically: audience in the masthead, the Terms bound, no cardinality in prose, and the one voice measured (around fifteen words a sentence, you present; RD.DOCS.043). It also carries refs/permission-vs-enablement.md — the first question an agent asks before declaring a gate: does the answer vary per person, per organization type, or per plan.

plugins.name: spn-apps-ts
plugins.description: SaaS Plane apps domain, TypeScript instance: the five APPS verb skills — new, implement, review, run, verify — the golden-path step files, and the TS standards digest. Planning is not here: the verb is DEVEX_PLAN and lives once in spn-core, which loads refs/plan.md from this plugin for the APPS · TS layer. The book's SPSkillType is closed and carries no APPS_PLAN. A hook denies a write that breaks the enablement grammar — an enablement code not prefixed by its own module, a code whose second segment is not MANAGE, a multi-value definition named after its area, and a hardcoded set of organization types in a service (RD.SAAS.033).

plugins.name: spn-infra
plugins.description: SaaS Plane infra domain — one plugin for every estate repo: the estate verb skills (declare, plan-review, module-author, release); the manifest and locator quick reference; the layer-noun and door card; the name and DNS grammar with the published vocabulary; the estate laws; and a hook that denies secrets, ARNs, account ids, provider strings outside a cloud entry, and hand edits to dist/.
